cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, time, subprocess, sys
LIMITS = {"images":16,"cells":262144,"units":1024,"contexts":32768,"connections":4096,"packets":32768,"files":8192}
def mk(events, extra=None):
    j = {"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":LIMITS,"events":events}
    if extra: j.update(extra)
    return j
# 1) four jobs x 200k valid events (total events bound exceeded after validation)
evs = [{"op":"inspect"} for _ in range(200000)]
data = json.dumps({"jobs":[mk(evs)]*4}, separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('size', len(data))
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'launch.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
print('4x200k valid-events jobs ->', p.stdout[:60], 'time %.1fs' % (time.time()-t))
# 2) four invalid jobs with 200k events each (walk cost)
data = json.dumps({"jobs":[mk(evs, extra={"x":1})]*4}, separators=(',',':')).encode()
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'launch.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
print('4x200k invalid jobs ->', p.stdout[:60], 'time %.1fs' % (time.time()-t))
# 3) deep structures inside invalid jobs
deep = 0
for _ in range(60): deep = [deep]
data = json.dumps({"jobs":[deep]*4}, separators=(',',':')).encode()
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'launch.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
print('deep invalid jobs ->', p.stdout[:60], 'time %.1fs' % (time.time()-t))
# 4) one valid 200k job with deep values in an extra field of a later event
evs = [{"op":"inspect"} for _ in range(199999)] + [{"op":"inspect","x":deep}]
data = json.dumps({"jobs":[mk(evs)]}, separators=(',',':')).encode()
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'launch.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
print('valid job with deep extra field ->', p.stdout[:60], 'time %.1fs' % (time.time()-t))
EOF
